newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian navy stages exercises with China.
newsitem.headline: Italian navy stages exercises with China.

text.p: Italy, a member of the NATO alliance, said on Friday that two of its ships had taken part in the first joint naval exercise between China and a western nation.
"For the first time, the Chinese navy has agreed to carry out a joint exercise with ships from a western country," the Italian navy said in a statement.
It said the manouevres took place off the port of Shanghai on Thursday after a week-long visit by the 27th group of the Italian navy which embarked on a round-the-world voyage in July.
Navy sources said the exercises, at the mouth of the Yangtze river, lasted about two hours.
The Chinese ships -- a destroyer and a frigate -- were joined by the Italian guided-missile destroyer Luigi Durand De La Penne and the frigate Bersagliere.
